lanes.label: Regional news metadata previews
lanes.promotion: Explicit reviewed decisions only; preview never writes accepted records.

publicationCoordinator: One reviewed release at a time; reserve the lane in its PR before mutation.
unchangedPolicy: No content commit or full Quality Gate for receipt-only changes; latest attempt stays in workflow artifact, not falsely reported as newly published data.
restrictionPolicy: Do not retry denied sources or expand permissions without changed authorization. Link the existing blocker rather than repeatedly researching it.
